name: Adaptive Audience Display – Login Based Visibility For Elementor Elements
author: Scott Mollett

sections.description:
Adaptive Audience Display adds login-based visibility controls to Elementor widgets, containers, and sections. It allows you to dynamically show or hide content based on whether the user is logged in or logged out.
Upgrade to Pro for advanced role-based visibility and premium features:
https://AdaptiveAudienceDisplay.com

Features

  • Visibility toggle for Elementor widgets, containers, and sections
  • Frontend enforcement after page republish
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • Popup-based instructions page in admin
  • Compatible with Elementor’s rendering pipeline

Upgrade to Pro

Upgrade to Pro for advanced features including:
* Role-based visibility control for most elements within Elementor.
* Advanced diagnostics.
https://AdaptiveAudienceDisplay.com

Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor.
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress plugin installer and Activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any Elementor widget, container, or section.
  3. Locate the “Adaptive Audience Display” panel in the Advanced tab.
  4. Choose visibility settings based on login state.
  5. Update and republish the page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support role-based visibility?

Role-based logic is available in the PRO version.

Does it work with Elementor containers and sections?

Yes, visibility logic applies to widgets, containers, and sections.

Do I need to republish the page for changes to apply?

Yes, visibility logic is enforced after republishing.
